prompt: It is their last day. A copy is running from a share they do not work in. They close the laptop.

choices.label: Let it go. It is their last day.
Ask them to stop, and leave it.

prompt: You do not know why they were copying the files.

choices.label: Be sure of the reason before you speak.
Report what the screen did, not why.
Asking them is the same as a report.

prompt: You were copied on a thread with account numbers. One reply is from outside the company.

choices.label: Delete it so it is not on you.
Report it on the posted channel.
Forward it to your manager and stop.

prompt: Your manager may be out when you forward the thread.

choices.label: A forward still counts if you sent it.
The posted channel is the one watched.
Wait until Monday and mention it.

prompt: The file share opens on a note. The files are locked. It says pay before midnight.

choices.label: Pay it from the department card.
Unplug, and call the incident number.
Wipe the machine so it cannot spread.

prompt: Wiping the machine would clear the locked files.

choices.label: It also clears what responders need.
A clean machine is the fastest fix.
